messages:
Emma (partnerships): Heads-up — SecretsBroker came back with a signed NDA and wants to start a joint integration for their Secrets Broker + KMS gateway. Goal: marketplace listing + coordinated announcement in ~6 weeks. Who can own the tech checklist?
Raj (security): I can own security signoffs. Need to validate HSM/KMS compatibility (KMIP vs provider APIs) and key wrapping.
Li (eng): I can take the integration work. Do they have a SCIM + SAML flow for user provisioning? Also need sample manifests for their connector.
Emma (partnerships): They support SCIM + SAML, and expose a KMS proxy endpoint for envelopes. They sent an initial integration spec in the S3 link: https://secretsbroker.example/sb-integration-spec.pdf 
Marco (product): Important we lock scope: supported cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, GCP) + private deployment docs. Also want a Redwood-side config model for customers to pick SecretsBroker as a KMS provider in Private/Dedicated.
Nora (legal): NDA looks fine. We'll need a joint announcement checklist and approval windows. Please add embargo dates — marketing needs 7 business days for PR review.
Sam (sales): We should flag top existing trial customers who asked for external KMS. If we can do early access with 2-3 accounts, that helps pipeline.
Li (eng): Tech checklist draft (initial):
```
- SCIM: map groups -> team roles, provisioning test org
- SAML: verify IdP metadata + sign/validate assertions
- KMS: envelope encryption flow, test key import, rotate test keys
- Network: VPC peering / private endpoint + TLS cert validation
- Logging: audit events to Redwood audit sink
- E2E: create sample app using Redwood Private with SecretsBroker KMS
```
Raj (security): Add: HSM attestation fingerprint check; crypto policy (allowed algorithms); CI integration for automated key rotation tests.
Emma (partnerships): Can we slot a technical sync with their lead engineer next Tue 10am PT? I suggested @Li + @Raj + @Marco.
deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled sync event created: secretsbroker-integration-sync @ 2027-01-14 10:00 PT — invite sent to participants.
Li (eng): Good. For SCIM mapping, they sent this example mapping snippet. We should confirm attribute names match our Identity model:
```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "user@example.com",
  "emails": [{"value": "user@example.com", "primary": true}],
  "groups": ["devs", "infra"]
}
```
Marco (product): For marketplace listing we need: 1) validated billing integration 2) SLA language 3) support contact + runbook. Can Eng produce a short runbook for on-call?
Raj (security): Runbook should include: how to revoke provider keys, how to failover to Redwood-managed KMS, and how to audit envelope signatures.
Nora (legal): Please add an IP/data flow appendix for review — SecretsBroker processes encrypted blobs but we need confirmation they don't persist unencrypted material. Ask them for a data retention statement.
Emma (partnerships): I'll request retention/attestation docs and an embargo window. Proposed announcement window: target date +6 weeks, embargo +5 days. Anyone see conflicts?
Sam (sales): +1 on the window. Want to offer early access to two enterprise prospects in EMEA — ping me for the list.
Li (eng): Technical blockers I foresee: customer-side key import API differences, and TLS client cert pinning for private endpoints. Need time for staging cert exchange.
Emma (partnerships): Action items (owner + ETA):
- Request retention/attestation docs from SecretsBroker (Emma) — ETA 48h
- Tech spec + SCIM/SAML test plan (Li) — ETA 4 business days
- Security checklist + HSM attestation requirements (Raj) — ETA 4 business days
- Legal appendix review (Nora) — ETA 7 business days
- Early access customer list (Sam) — ETA 3 business days
- Marketplace listing draft (Marco) — ETA 10 business days

Raj (security): I'll add the CI test matrix as a PR to the infra repo once Li posts the spec. Include tests: key unwrap/rewrap, rotate while in-use, tamper detection.
Li (eng): Also, quick config example for Redwood Private customers will look like: `kms_provider: secretsbroker
endpoint: https://kms.secretsbroker.example
key_id: sb-prod-123` — we'll formalize fields.
Emma (partnerships): Can someone own the joint announcement logistics (press draft, social assets)? Marco?
Marco (product): I can coordinate with marketing for the deck and PR draft. Need a short technical summary and a one-liner from the CEO.
Nora (legal): I'll pre-clear the announcement language and embargo clause. If they request logo usage, require brand guidelines and a mutual approval step.
Sam (sales): Once we have early access, I'll set up two joint customer calls (EMEA / NA) for references.
Li (eng): Quick ask to SecretsBroker on the next sync: can they provide a staging instance with sample keys + SCIM test tenant? Put that in the agenda.
Emma (partnerships): Noted — I'll add it. Final note: please keep the integration branch behind feature flag and disable it by default for hosted users. We only enable for Private/Dedicated early access customers. :lock:
Raj (security): Agreed. We'll also require a completed security checklist before enabling for any account. :white_check_mark:
Emma (partnerships): Thanks all — I'll post the summary and update this thread after the sync tomorrow. :eyes:
